    Meradeb Hotkeys

    Window Management

    Hotkey Action

    Super + w Close window

    Super + ↑ Maximize window

    Super + h Minimize window

    Super + Backspace Resize window

    Super + t Check window layout

    Shift + F11 Fullscreen

    Window Navigation

    Hotkey Action

    Super + Shift + h Shift focus to window on left

    Super + Shift + l Shift focus to window on right

    Super + Shift + j Shift focus to window below

    Super + Shift + k Shift focus to window above

    Shift + F11 Fullscreen

    Workspaces

    Hotkey Action

    Alt + 1 Workspace 1

    Alt + 2 Workspace 2

    Alt + 3 Workspace 3

    Alt + 4 Workspace 4

    Alt + 5 Workspace 5

    Alt + 6 Workspace 6

    Pinned/Dock Applications

    Hotkey Action

    Super + 1-9 Launch / switch to pinned app

    Applications

    Hotkey Action

    Super + Space Wofi launcher

    Ctrl + Print Flameshot screenshot

    Shift + Alt + 1 New Ghostty window

    Shift + Alt + 2 New Firefox window
